name: smwgraphics-chrono-trigger-death-peak-sky
title: Chrono Trigger - Death Peak (Sky)
description:
The gorgeous background that appears in the summit the Death Peak, from Chrono Trigger. Could be used for a cutscene, boss arena or maybe, a title screen. It will get odd if looped, so it's recommended to use only for one screen.

UPDATE: Optimized gfx files, map 16 and palette, in general. For the red variant, at least.

Added another variant, which is a blue sky, seen when Crono is revived. Both of them have the eclipse area using the back area color.

The blue variant uses a bit more tiles, due to slightly different tiles near the bottom.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
